title: gabo project config (gabo.yaml)
description: Team keys of the project gabo.yaml (DB_SCHEMA 3.2). Personal keys belong in the global user file (gabo.user.schema.json). Secrets never appear here, only environment variable names (R21). A null or empty optional value means unset, as the Go loader reads it.
$comment: The names below close the object; their rules live in $defs/projectKeys.

projectKeys.description: Every project key with its value rules and no required key: a layer may hold only some of them.

version.description: Schema version of this file; missing reads as 0.

integration_branch.description: The only branch auto mode may merge into, never main (D13).

runtimes.description: Agent runtime per role: coder takes one engine name or session (the role runs in the main session, valid only with assistant set); reviewer takes one of the four reviewer engines or session; assistant takes one engine name or a non-empty list of distinct engine names.

login.description: GitHub login the coder pushes with; it must never merge.

checks.description: Commands run in order in a credential-free copy of the merged tree; each is split on whitespace, no shell.

auto_merge.description: Whether the reviewer merges a clean head into the integration branch.

human_only_paths.description: Repository-relative paths only a human may change.

pi_credential_env.description: Optional, read only by a pi reviewer: name of the environment variable whose value the review step gets instead of reusing the owner's Pi login. The value never enters the config (R21).

check_env.description: Names of environment variables the reviewer passes from its own environment into the checks, never into the agent review; a listed variable unset or empty at review time fails the checks. Names only: values never enter the config (R21). The reviewer's own variables and credentials are reserved.

state_dir.description: Absolute path of the reviewer's clone and workspaces.

keep.description: Worktree names or absolute paths that are never closed.

parallelism.description: Most coder sessions the cycle runs at once within one wave, that is within one intent's tasks.

slots.description: Adapter Markdown file per slot contract (D2, TRD 9.1).

placement.description: Where the reviewer runs; only local is available (D6). server, github-actions and gitlab-ci are planned for a later release.

marker.description: Marker the reviewer writes in its verdict comment.

developers.description: Developer catalog: git email to alias (D10).

scope.description: Widest plan scope agents may change (R19, D7): task is one task in one intent's plan.md; group is one whole intent, its spec.md and plan.md; global is several intents or the PRD/TRD conventions.

global_without_owner.description: Whether a global-scope change (several intents or the PRD/TRD conventions) may apply without the owner (D7).

wave.description: How waves chain. A wave is one intent; chaining is optional.

after.description: What the assistant does when a wave closes: next starts the next intent whose spec is accepted and that has unblocked tasks; wait stops and reports. Unset means wait. With no eligible intent it waits either way.

complete.description: Keys a complete config must set (R12): gabo fills none of them.

layer.description: One config file as the loader reads it: every project and personal key, none required. The loader checks required keys on the merged result.

file.description: A complete config file with every key class, as given with --config.

engine.description: An engine name (intent 0017 D2): lower case letters, digits and '-', starting with a letter. Any such name is accepted here; gabo check then needs its runtime skill. session is not an engine.

runtime.description: One engine name or null (missing). session is not an engine.

roleRuntime.$comment: if/then/else keeps one refusal line per bad value, the single-value line of 0.2.10.

reviewerRuntime.$comment: The reviewer runs only the engines the reviewer scripts run (TRD D27, intent 0017 D3); session runs it in the main session.

assistant.$comment: if/then/else keeps one refusal line per bad value, the single-value line of 0.2.10.

adapter.description: Repository-relative path of the adapter file; for methodology it may also be a skill name.

relativePath.description: A non-empty path inside the repository: no leading slash and no '..' segment.
